_comment: EventBridge Scheduled Rule — Secrets Rotation every 30 days at 2:00 AM UTC
_deploy_instructions: This file is used by deploy.sh — do not apply manually

rule.Name: pip-project-ecommerce-secrets-rotation-schedule
rule.Description: Trigger secrets rotation Lambda every 30 days at 2:00 AM UTC (7:30 AM IST). Low-traffic window chosen to minimise impact of JWT secret rotation (all sessions invalidated).

target._comment_schedule: cron(0 2 1 * ? *) = 02:00 UTC on the 1st of every month

_schedule_options.monthly_first: cron(0 2 1 * ? *)    — 1st of each month at 02:00 UTC
_schedule_options.every_30_days: rate(30 days)         — every 30 days from creation
_schedule_options.db_only_weekly: cron(0 2 ? * SUN *)  — DB password every Sunday (aggressive)
